description: Unpack an Electron .asar archive to a scratch directory, under resource caps (max total declared size, max file count) checked from the archive header before any bytes are written. Refuses to partially extract: returns truncated:true with nothing written if the archive exceeds the caps. Use when you need to analyze the JS inside a packaged Electron app and rure_analyze_js_app rejects the .asar path directly.
name: rure_extract_asar
